article.title: Run into
article.description: Meaning 1: to meet someone unexpectedly. Example: 'I ran into an old friend at the mall.' Meaning 2: to encounter a problem. Example: 'We ran into some issues with the schedule.' Grammar note: inseparable phrasal verb — the object always comes after 'into'.
article.content: Meaning 1: to meet someone unexpectedly. Example: 'I ran into an old friend at the mall.' Meaning 2: to encounter a problem. Example: 'We ran into some issues with the schedule.' Grammar note: inseparable phrasal verb — the object always comes after 'into'.

generated.caption:
Ever met someone by total surprise or hit an unexpected snag? You can use "run into"!

This versatile phrasal verb means to meet someone unexpectedly, like "I ran into an old friend at the mall." It also means to encounter a problem, for example, "We ran into some issues with the schedule." Remember, 'run into' stays together!

generated.script: Ye "run into" sunke kabhi confusion hua hai? Aksar log iska galat matlab nikaalte hain! Well, iske do bahut important meanings hain. Pehla, "run into" ka matlab hai to meet someone unexpectedly. Jaise, I ran into an old friend at the mall. Matlab, main apne ek purane dost se mall mein unexpectedly mil gaya. Aur dusra matlab hai to encounter a problem. Example: We ran into some issues with the schedule. Yaani, humein schedule mein kuch issues aa gaye. Aur haan, object hamesha 'into' ke baad hi aata hai. Ab yaad rakhna, "run into" matlab ya toh unexpectedly kisi se milna, ya fir koi problem face karna. Ab confusion nahi hoga, right? Comment karke batao aapko "run into" ka ye matlab pata tha ya nahi! slides.headlineRest: — Two Key Meanings You Need to Know
slides.body: 'Run into' is a versatile phrasal verb with two important meanings. Firstly, it means to meet someone unexpectedly, as in, 'I ran into an old friend at the mall.' Secondly, it can describe encountering a problem or difficulty, such as when 'we ran into some issues with the schedule.' Remember, it's an inseparable phrasal verb, so the object always comes after 'into'.
slides.hindiSummary: "Run into" का मतलब है अचानक किसी से मिलना या किसी समस्या का सामना करना।
